matches_to_count_before_any_trait_rate.strict: Same original ref_ID + normalized plant binomial + exact trait_type label + exact ordered original collection-location pair, with at least one Genetic and one Phenotypic record.
matches_to_count_before_any_trait_rate.intermediate: Same original ref_ID + normalized plant binomial + exact trait_type, with both categories, regardless of exact geographic-pair equality. Not sufficient for direct phenotype vs genetic separation.
matches_to_count_before_any_trait_rate.species_only: Same plant species and trait_type across any source studies, with both categories. Not sufficient for direct phenotype vs genetic separation.

interpretation_limits: PROCEED source Genetic labels refer to efforts to measure a heritable phenotype component and do not establish selection or reciprocal-transplant adaptation.
PROCEED Phenotypic labels refer to field phenotype, which includes both genetic and environmental contributions and is not a direct measure of within-genotype plasticity.
Even an exact study-species-trait-geographic overlap does not prove same genotypes, measurement methods or experimental assignments without source papers.
Do not infer fraction due to phenotypic plasticity by subtracting two unpaired published rates.
